Main Upgrading Programme:
Interior upgrading programmes for flats built up to 1986, and
HIP which have not undergone MUP, with added optional improvements
Home Improvement Programme:
Interior upgrading programmes for flats built up to 1986, and
HIP which have not undergone MUP, with added optional improvements
Interim Upgrading Programme: The common areas of a precinct were upgraded, landscape upgrading programmes stopped in flavour of IUP Plus
Selective En bloc Redevelopment Scheme: Launched in August 1995 to renew old housing estates in Singapore. Offers flat owners a unique opportunity to move to a new home near their existing estate.
Lift Upgrading Programme: Direct level access to lift for flats.
Interim Upgrading Programme Plus: Direct level access to lift for flats.
Neighbourhood Renewal Programme: This would include MUP/HIP (interior) and IUP Plus (landscape) as it focus on block and neighbourhood improvements
